scope: Omaha city research via Douglas County, Nebraska local GIS/assessor custody and the Nebraska statewide parcel REST service.

officialSources.observation: Official Douglas County GIS hub says it provides GIS services to Douglas County and the City of Omaha and public map/data resources.
Assessor GIS page describes a county cadastral mapping system with parcel boundary polygons and parcel search.
Nebraska Department of Revenue lists Michael Goodwillie, Douglas County Assessor, and Beacon parcel search for Douglas County.

Official Nebraska REST metadata identifies StatewideParcels as esriGeometryPolygon, compiled from county CAMA and geospatial polygon features, with JSON/GeoJSON query support and fields including State_PID, Parcel_ID, and County_ID.
